verdicts.reason: Both break the original the same ways: the date tile shrinks to an unreadable chip, the 'LISTENING SESSION' eyebrow becomes tiny fine print stuck on the end of the body line, the dark circle has come away from the headphones and floats on its own at the right edge, and the 'RSVP Free' button is so small it gets lost. A also leaves a dead gap on the left and squeezes the date chip between the headline and the headphones, so the order goes headline → date → headphones. B keeps the date at the far left, as in the original, which reads a little better, but it still has a big gap between the chip and the headline.
